description: This file defines the 'RunFromPool' class which models the <run-from-pool> XML element within the OFBiz service configuration framework. It provides a constructor to instantiate the object from an XML Element and a getter for the 'name' attribute.

classes.name: RunFromPool
classes.description: A class representing the <run-from-pool> element in service configuration XML, encapsulating its 'name' attribute.

methods.name: RunFromPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on the provided XML Element; throws ServiceConfigException if the 'name' attribute is missing or empty.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the run-from-pool element.
